The investigation will examine loan disbursements, borrower identities, asset classifications and fund usage, with findings potentially shaping regulatory action and the lender’s financial outlook.

banking-economy.title: Bajaj Finserv says Deepak Reddy appointed as CEO designate of Bajaj General Insurance
